name: Katarina
source:
“I am Katarina Phil Meidi—daughter of the distinguished Meidi family, and rightful candidate for queen.”

The younger sister of Salinas. Before the heroine’s arrival, she was destined to marry Gizeld as the “Holy Maiden candidate.”
Initially hostile toward the heroine, Katarina gradually softens as their paths intertwine, revealing the gentle, compassionate heart she had kept hidden.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url]]

She is nameable in [url=/v59178]The Goddess Of Tears ～Restoration～Katarina Hen[/url].
